constraints: Requires access to the Design environment; otherwise error -9804 ("Cannot open form") is generated.
If form does not exist, error 81 ("Form not found") is generated.
The command is asynchronous: it returns immediately without waiting for the editor to actually open.
If object is not found in form, the form still opens and no error is returned.
Passing an empty string in object deselects all objects in the open form.

overloadMerges.note: The two doc syntax lines differ only by the trailing optional object parameter; merged into one overload with object optional, matching the actual calling convention (object may be omitted, an existing name/group, an unmatched name, or an empty string to deselect all).

params.name: aTable
params.description: Table owning the form (table form); if omitted, form is a project form

params.name: form
params.description: Name of the form to open in the 4D Form editor

params.name: object
params.description: Name of a form object or group to select automatically; pass an empty string to deselect all objects

sentinelValues.meaning: deselect all objects in the open form

overloadMerges.semanticRole: Opens the specified form (project or table form) in the 4D Form editor, asynchronously, optionally pre-selecting a named object or group (or deselecting all, if object is an empty string).
